description: This PHP source file defines the 'Language' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It handles displaying and updating the language selection for the admin interface, including loading language data, setting cookies, and redirection.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing language selection and switching in the administrative interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the language selection page, loads available languages, and determines the redirect URL based on current request parameters.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the request to change the language, sets a cookie for the selected language, and handles redirection post-selection.
